title: GodScar: Which lightning effect looks better?
author: irbrandonl
selftext:
Hey everyone! Back with another quick development update for GODSCAR, my dark fantasy turn-based RPG!

This time, I wanted to try something a little different and get some feedback from you guys.

I've been working on improving the battle animations and visual effects, and one thing I'm really focusing on is making each attack feel impactful and satisfying.

In this video, I'm showing two different versions of a lightning spell. Both accomplish the same thing, but they have very different visual styles and levels of intensity.

Option A — A simpler, more restrained lightning effect.

Option B — A bigger, more explosive lightning strike with a lot more visual impact.

I'm trying to find the right balance between making abilities look impressive while still keeping battles readable and making sure stronger abilities feel noticeably more powerful.

So which one do you prefer, A or B? And what would you change about either one?

I'm still making major updates to the battle system so any feedback would be greatly appreciated!

Made with Opus 5.5 on Extra Effort

comments.author: Horror-Detective4138
comments.body: You don't necessarily have to do different levels for all spells, but perhaps ramp their visuals up based on that type of logic.

comments.author: Entropydemic
comments.body: I like A because it's fast, but B because it's aggressive. A seems useful for single targets and B looks like area of effect. If you absolutely can't use both, I'd say A, because it isn't so busy. Still, the visual delight of B is hard to ignore. Might be cool if it's A, but a critical strike could use B.
